Owner(s).value: SWP Stadtwerke Pforzheim GmbH & Co. KG [100%]
Owner(s).note: The Stadtwerke Pforzheim page on the combined heat and power plant says the five new gas engines opened in June 2021. Its emission measurement reports for the gas engine plant are issued by SWP Stadtwerke Pforzheim GmbH und Co. KG. A Wikipedia article on the utility says the utility took over Heizkraftwerk Pforzheim GmbH in 2020 after holding 90 percent before. So the plant now appears to be held by the utility itself, not by the old company that GEM lists. The share is not stated on the page, so this needs a second source before GEM changes the owner.

Latitude.note: The Stadtwerke Pforzheim legal notice lists the power plant at Hohwiesenweg 15, 75175 Pforzheim. A map lookup of that address gives about 48.8971 north and 8.7255 east, roughly 70 meters from the coordinates GEM already holds. So the existing point is consistent with the plant site. The page itself does not print coordinates.
